reason: My regulars and Google reviews bring my customers, and I've never needed creators. Who are you? A beta startup offering to pay me ₹200 a month sounds like it could disappear next month, so I won't make my counter staff learn a PIN system for it.
objection: A small new startup paying businesses to join makes me wonder how it makes money and whether it will still be here in three months. I also don't want strangers posting about my café when I don't know them.
would_change_my_mind: Another café or darshini owner I know nearby telling me they got real new customers through it, with the coupon numbers to prove it.
